text:
# Close wrap, Mon 2026-11-09

**Indexes:** S&P +2.3%, Dow +2.1–2.2%, Nasdaq +2.7%; best S&P day since April, second straight gain after last week's AI/midterm rout. Brent −5.8% on Trump calling new Iran strikes "highly unlikely" did a lot of the lifting ([AP](https://apnews.com/article/stocks-markets-ai-trump-oil-d938f8e6ff42b3706e1d36e6245ec56b); [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-monday-november-9-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-nvidia-090535419.html); [Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4669207-us-equities-ended-higher-and-erased-the-election-day-losses)).

**Sectors/covered names:** AI "picks and shovels" led: MPWR +16.7%, AMD +9.5% to +13.4% (sources differ) on Oppenheimer upgrade, AMAT +9.0%, AVGO +8.0%, MU +5.9%, TSLA +5.7%, BE +13.9%, LITE +12.0%. NVDA −4.2% to $178.81 on the Huang board probe ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/amd-tesla-among-market-cap-stock-movers-on-monday-93CH-5012779); [24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/cards/chips-split-hard-at-monday-s-close-four-names-finished-up-d-mpwr-session-movers-01m712efvjzszttbk8bj2sv5zb)). Energy (XOM, CVX, COP, OXY, EOG) fell with crude ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/09/stock-market-movers-live-updates.html)). TTWO −3.6% into its report.

**After hours:** RKLB rev $267.8M beat, EPS −$0.12 vs −$0.06 est. ([Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/news/earnings/26/11/63069541/rocket-lab-usa-q3-eps-0-12-misses-0-06-estimate-sales-267-834m-beat-255-709m-estimate)); early AH moves: TTD and RKLB up, HIMS and TTWO down, OXY ~flat to −1% ([StockCatalyst](https://www.thestockcatalyst.com/NasdaqAHEarningsHistoryByDate)).

**Tomorrow:** Oct CPI 8:30 (core est. +0.2% m/m), Dec hike odds ~77–80%; BMO TDG, SE, ONON; AMC CRWV. Wed bond market closed.

**Ideas:** No new swing longs logged. Lessons say don't add into the first bounce after a sector shock or the night before CPI. Carry SAP (low, logged this morning) as the only fresh idea; risk is an upgrade-only catalyst plus CPI. AI-hardware group avoid stays through 11/10 and gets revisited at Tuesday's close (CEG first in line).
